title: ChatGPT Launches Custom Sticker Feature, Perfectly Integrates with Two Major Social Media Giants

content_html:
OpenAI has officially launched a new custom sticker feature for its AI assistant ChatGPT, further expanding the application boundaries of AI in the field of mass social content creation.

In terms of core features, users can create personalized stickers through various intuitive methods. Whether it's directly uploading photos, entering text prompts, or skillfully transferring different visual art styles, ChatGPT can easily handle it. This feature not only includes powerful intelligent image cropping and repair technology that can automatically generate clean transparent background stickers, but also allows users to package multiple works into complete custom sticker packs.

In terms of ecosystem interoperability and export experience, the new feature demonstrates high practicality. Users can not only save the created stickers directly to their phone's photo album, but also seamlessly export them to mainstream instant messaging apps such as iMessage and WhatsApp. Specifically, for the WhatsApp platform, there are certain rule requirements: at least three stickers must be included each time they are exported; when stickers are successfully exported to Apple's iMessage, they will automatically be categorized and placed in a dedicated sticker area, making it convenient for users to call them anytime during daily chats.

The launch of this feature not only gives users a more interesting way to express themselves personally, but also marks that ChatGPT is accelerating its integration into users' daily social lives, bringing a more diverse and rich interactive experience.
